sprints.title: Exam Blueprint
sprints.subtitle: Start from official objectives
sprints.lesson: Understand the tested topics before memorizing details. If a domain is not yet studied, schedule a lesson and practice check before calling it complete.
sprints.example: A study plan should cover each published exam objective, rather than relying only on favorite topics.
sprints.trap: Do not assume every exam uses the same scoring method or question types.
sprints.takeaway: Check the current official exam guide before studying.

sprints.title: Fast Learning
sprints.subtitle: Explain before memorizing
sprints.lesson: Use a concise explanation, then demonstrate a practical example. A short explanation can be expanded into a concrete scenario and a short check.
sprints.example: After reading a concept, summarize it without looking and explain when it applies.
sprints.trap: Simply rereading the same paragraph is not a reliable mastery check.
sprints.takeaway: Explain it simply, then retrieve it unaided.

sprints.title: Active Recall
sprints.subtitle: Practice retrieval
sprints.lesson: Try answering without revealing hints, then inspect why each option is right or wrong. Answer first and reveal the explanation afterward.
sprints.example: Before reviewing a definition, describe it aloud from memory and check mistakes.
sprints.trap: Memorizing option letters is not learning the underlying concept.
sprints.takeaway: Recall first, read the explanation second.

sprints.title: Scenario Reasoning
sprints.subtitle: Choose based on requirements
sprints.lesson: Identify constraints, eliminate distractors, and justify a choice. Ask what the scenario requires before jumping to a familiar product or command.
sprints.example: A scenario mentions time, cost, and security: decide which requirement actually controls the answer.
sprints.trap: The first familiar keyword does not automatically identify the correct answer.

sprints.title: Hands-On Drills
sprints.subtitle: Practice doing, not only reading
sprints.lesson: Order steps, interpret commands, and validate expected outcomes. Troubleshoot a wrong sequence by checking dependencies between steps.
sprints.example: In a CLI exercise, order setup, execution, checking, and cleanup.
sprints.trap: A memorized command can still be used in the wrong order or context.
sprints.takeaway: Sequence matters as much as syntax.

sprints.title: Review & Progress
sprints.subtitle: Return to weak areas
sprints.lesson: Use misses, confidence, and spaced practice to prioritize the next review. Keep a record of what you missed and check improvement after a break.
sprints.example: After missing multiple questions in one area, return to the objective and retry with new examples.
sprints.trap: A high score on repeated identical questions may overstate readiness.
sprints.takeaway: Track weak spots; practice until reasoning improves.

rhymes.title: Exam objectives
rhymes.rhyme:
Start with the guide, make a map;
Cover each domain, close the gap.
rhymes.explanation: Check the current blueprint and track objective coverage.

rhymes.title: Practice recall
rhymes.rhyme:
Answer first, then see the why;
Find the gap and give it a try.
rhymes.explanation: Use retrieval before looking at explanations.

rhymes.title: Scenario clues
rhymes.rhyme:
Read the need before you choose;
Miss the constraint and you may lose.
rhymes.explanation: Requirements matter more than keyword recognition.

rhymes.title: Distractors
rhymes.rhyme:
Sounds so close, but fails the test;
Match each rule to find the best.
rhymes.explanation: Explain why plausible wrong choices fail.

rhymes.title: Lab order
rhymes.rhyme:
Setup first, then run the flow;
Check the result before you go.

rhymes.title: Review plan
rhymes.rhyme:
Wrong today? Review with care;
Fresh questions show what stayed there.
rhymes.explanation: Revisit weak areas with new questions.

rhymes.title: Timeboxing
rhymes.rhyme:
Set the clock and name the aim;
Learn the skill, not just the game.
rhymes.explanation: Time limits should support practice, not distract from it.

rhymes.title: Progress
rhymes.rhyme:
Check the score, but also why;
Numbers cannot certify you by.
rhymes.explanation: Practice progress is not an official certification score.

rhymes.title: Sources
rhymes.rhyme:
Source it well, confirm the date;
Changed exams do not sit and wait.
rhymes.explanation: Verify versions and technical details from official references.

rhymes.title: Switching
rhymes.rhyme:
New exam pack, same study view;
Keep old progress while learning new.
rhymes.explanation: Keep content and saved progress separate for each certification.
